title: Tower 4
scene: The Menace is parked on a wide paved shoulder just before the I-5 south ramp, engine still, key in. Overcast midday. Clipboard on your thigh. The log line is I-5 south, I-90 east, valley floor only — Tower 4. CARGO is the relay kit that already fits this car: repeater set, antenna, mast clamps, lashed in the back. Nobody in the other seat. Mya is a loaf on the dash because the wheels are not turning. The mountain sits in the east as a shape, not a road. The schedule does not climb today.
debrief: Parked: cluster at zero, clipboard on your thigh, Mya on the dash. The kit sits lashed in the back for Tower 4.

source.teaching_target: Establish the Ribbon and the locked load: relay kit (repeater, antenna, mast clamps) for Tower 4, riding in the Menace. Ali alone.

image_brief.subject: Ali chest-up in the parked Menace, glasses, mesh behind her, no second occupant; Mya a brown mackerel loaf on the dash
